title: I am creating a Roguelite about Gnomes invading a town with the help of Claude! Please give me some feedback!
author: Kissafa
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I am pretty new to this but I am creating a game called 'We've got a Gnome Problem!'.

Using Claude has been a godsend to get some of the features working together nicely and for bug fixing. I was wondering if I could get a few different AI models working together on a project, I know I could probably research this and find the answer but if anyone does this or can recommend anything that would be great.

I have just uploaded a Demo to Itch and would love some feedback!

[https://kissafa.itch.io/weve-got-a-gnome-problem-demo](https://kissafa.itch.io/weve-got-a-gnome-problem-demo)

Thank you so much!

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body: Looks fun, will be interesting to see the roguelite elements and the challenge but good theme and UI
